name: agribalyse-3.2-stripped-ecoinvent-processes
description: Process blocks removed from the ADEME SimaPro export of Agribalyse 3.2 to produce the ecoinvent-free CSV. One row per removed block: SimaPro process identifier, process type and the sha256 of the removed block. No names and no amounts. Anyone holding the full export can re-run dds-strip-ecoinvent and compare.
